_schema.name: _migrations
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE _migrations (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      applied_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('2026-05-13 09:00:00'))
    )

_schema.name: mock_user
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE mock_user (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      display_name TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('2026-05-13 09:00:00'))
    )

_schema.name: health_daily_snapshot
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE health_daily_snapshot (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      date TEXT NOT NULL,
      steps INTEGER,
      active_energy_kcal REAL,
      sleep_hours REAL,
      sleep_quality REAL,
      light_sleep_hours REAL,
      deep_sleep_hours REAL,
      rem_sleep_hours REAL,
      low_intensity_min REAL,
      medium_intensity_min REAL,
      high_intensity_min REAL,
      total_activity_min REAL,
      resting_heart_rate_bpm INTEGER,
      avg_heart_rate_bpm INTEGER,
      weight_kg REAL,
      body_fat_percent REAL,
      blood_oxygen_percent REAL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('2026-05-13 09:00:00')),
      UNIQUE(user_id, date),
      FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES mock_user(id)
    )

_schema.name: health_metric_series
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE health_metric_series (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      metric_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      date TEXT NOT NULL,
      value REAL NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('2026-05-13 09:00:00')),
      UNIQUE(user_id, metric_type, date),
      FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES mock_user(id)
    )

_schema.name: allergen
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE allergen (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      severity TEXT,
      notes TEXT,
      archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      archived_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('2026-05-13 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('2026-05-13 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES mock_user(id)
    )

_schema.name: medication
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE medication (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      display_name TEXT,
      frequency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'daily',
      dose_amount REAL,
      dose_unit TEXT,
      start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      end_date TEXT,
      notes TEXT,
      archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      archived_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('2026-05-13 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('2026-05-13 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES mock_user(id)
    )

_schema.name: medication_intake_slot
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE medication_intake_slot (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      medication_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      time_hhmm TEXT NOT NULL,
      dose_amount REAL,
      dose_unit TEXT,
      label TEXT,
      FOREIGN KEY (medication_id) REFERENCES medication(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

_schema.name: medication_dose_log
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE medication_dose_log (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      medication_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      slot_id INTEGER,
      logged_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('2026-05-13 09:00:00')),
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'taken',
      log_dose_amount REAL,
      log_dose_unit TEXT,
      notes TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('2026-05-13 09:00:00')),
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('2026-05-13 09:00:00')),
      FOREIGN KEY (medication_id) REFERENCES medication(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      FOREIGN KEY (slot_id) REFERENCES medication_intake_slot(id)
    )

_schema.name: idx_snapshot_user_date
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_snapshot_user_date ON health_daily_snapshot(user_id, date)

_schema.name: idx_metric_user_type_date
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_metric_user_type_date ON health_metric_series(user_id, metric_type, date)

_schema.name: idx_allergen_user
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_allergen_user ON allergen(user_id, archived)

_schema.name: idx_medication_user
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_medication_user ON medication(user_id, archived)

_schema.name: idx_dose_log_medication
_schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_dose_log_medication ON medication_dose_log(medication_id, logged_at)

_schema.name: system_config
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE system_config (
      key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      value TEXT NOT NULL
    )
